title: Falcon MLR Strategy - EU
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role

MLR review is one of the Life Science industry's biggest bottlenecks - and we're rebuilding it with AI.

Falcon MLR is Veeva's AI application for medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review. Our AI agents review promotional material the way expert reviewers do: against the actual rules of each market and the science behind the claims. We're looking for an MLR expert to take ownership of review quality across Europe.

You have sat in the review meetings. You know the codes, the process, and their pain points. Now, help build the reviewer and shape the future of MLR for the entire Life Science industry. You'll work directly with Falcon MLR's founding team, and your judgment will ship into a product used globally by the top Pharmaceutical companies.

We work like a start-up inside Veeva. The team is small, you own your area end to end, and your decisions reach the product fast. It suits people who like to build and take ownership.

Jobs that combine deep MLR expertise with frontier AI barely exist. This is one.

What You'll Do

• Maximize reviewer agreement with Falcon's findings across our EU markets

• Lead our regulatory monitoring system with engineering and product, and coordinate with other regions

• Operationalize the reviewer-feedback loop, turning customer inputs into product improvements

• Investigate, diagnose and resolve “why did Falcon flag this?” - read the agent's traces, find the root cause, fix it. Build the process for handling these questions with users

• Automate recurring tasks with AI workflows

• Ownership of quality benchmarks e.g. review quality, in cross functional collaboration with engineering and product

Requirements

• You have been part of MLR/PRC review of promotional material - in pharma, biotech or at an agency serving one

• You know the European codes - EFPIA, or national ones like ABPI, ENLI, FSA, Farmindustria, LEEM

• You learn dense regulatory and legal material fast - and have results to show

• AI is already part of your daily work - you have automated parts of your own job and want to go further

• You have worked hands-on in Vault PromoMats - reviews, annotations, claims libraries

• You live in the EU

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A personality assessment

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

• Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave

• Global Mobile phone & Internet Policy

• Veeva 1% Giving

• Fitness Reimbursements

• Veeva Break

Compensation

• Total Compensation: 90,000 - 140,000 EUR

title: Renewals Manager - Federal
description:
What You Can Expect
As a Renewals Manager on the Federal team, you’ll take ownership of a strategic book of federal business, protecting and growing Zoom’s installed base through disciplined renewal management and meaningful customer engagement. Your work will shift between finalizing renewals, forecasting pipeline, and uncovering expansion opportunities that create lasting value for government customers. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Finance, and Customer Success to navigate complex deals and build the trust that keeps federal agencies coming back. This is a quota-carrying role that rewards strategic thinkers who bring genuine curiosity to customer challenges and care deeply about long-term outcomes.

About the Team
The Renewals team at Zoom sits at the intersection of customer success and revenue growth, focused on retention, expansion, and delivering measurable value across Zoom’s customer base. On the Federal side, the team partners closely with account teams to strengthen relationships with government agencies, navigate complex procurement cycles, and ensure Zoom’s platform continues to meet mission-critical needs.

Responsibilities

• Manage and track a federal renewals book of business with a focus on growing MRR and NRR

• Negotiate renewal terms, pricing, and contract extensions, with an emphasis on upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year agreements

• Articulate Zoom’s platform value from a benefits and TCO perspective, adapting messaging to different stakeholder personas

• Develop and execute renewal strategies to maximize customer retention and revenue, using market trend analysis and customer data to surface improvement opportunities

• Build consultative relationships with federal customers through proactive renewal activities, including renewal reviews, discovery sessions, and executive outreach, while advocating for customer needs internally

• Lead retention efforts for at-risk accounts by facilitating TCO and competitive discussions and fostering cross-functional accountability

• Gather and incorporate customer feedback to continuously improve the renewal experience

• Forecast weekly, quarterly, and quarter+1 renewal opportunities, churn, risks, and upsell potential using Clari, and maintain accurate customer records in Salesforce

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in a SaaS or cloud company, with a background in sales, customer success, or renewals

• Have experience working within the Federal vertical

• Proven experience managing complex renewal negotiations and multi-year contract structures

• Strong collaboration, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with a track record of client satisfaction and cross-functional teamwork

• Proficiency in renewal forecasting, pipeline development, and opportunity management

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to deliver strategic, audience-tailored presentations

• Familiarity with CRM and revenue operations tools such as Salesforce and Clari

• Reside in the Northeast region

title: Account Executive – Combatant Commands (COCOMs)
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Sales Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword - it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce 's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce .
Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis. We are seeking a high-caliber Account Executive with a "mission-first" mindset to drive digital transformation across the Combatant Commands (COCOMs) . This isn't just about selling software; it’s about delivering the Integrated Deterrence and Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) capabilities required for the modern battlefield.
You will be the primary strategist for navigating the complex procurement and operational environments of organizations like INDOPACOM, EUCOM, CENTCOM, and SOCOM . You’ll bridge the gap between tactical needs at the edge and enterprise-scale SaaS solutions.
Key Responsibilities

•
Mission Alignment: Identify and map Salesforce ’s SaaS/PaaS capabilities to specific COCOM mission requirements, including readiness, logistics, situational awareness, and partner nation collaboration.

•
Strategic Navigation: Navigate the unique funding streams of the COCOMs (e.g., O&M, Procurement, and RDT&E) and work closely with Service Components and DISA.

•
Executive Relationship Management: Build and maintain deep-rooted relationships with Flag Officers, SES-level leadership, and J-code directors (J1-J9).

•
Ecosystem Orchestration: Collaborate with Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, and the broader defense industrial base to deliver "Mission Ready" solutions on the Salesforce Government Cloud.

•
Pipeline Excellence: Manage the full sales lifecycle-from initial mission discovery and "Art of the Possible" demos to closing complex, multi-million dollar ACV deals.

Required Qualifications

•
COCOM Domain Expertise: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience directly engaging with or working within the COCOM structure. You must understand the nuances of the Unified Command Plan and how COCOMs interface with the Pentagon and Service Branches.

•
SaaS Sales Pedigree: Proven track record of exceeding quotas in the SaaS/Cloud space. You understand the shift from "box software" to agile, consumption-based, or subscription-based digital platforms.

•
The " Salesforce Advantage": Familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack) and how these tools drive decision advantage.

•
Clearance: Must hold (or be eligible for) a Top Secret/SCI clearance .

•
Strategic Vision: Ability to translate complex technical requirements into high-level mission impact stories for non-technical senior leaders.

Preferred Attributes

•
Military Background: Former O-4+ or E-8+ with staff experience at a Combatant Command is a significant plus.

•
Technical Fluency: Understanding of IL4/IL5/IL6 security requirements and Data-at-the-Edge challenges.

•
Relentless Drive: A self-starter who thrives in the "grey space" of defense procurement.

title: Agentic Delivery Analyst Intern
description:
This is a remote position.
The Agentic Delivery Analyst Intern keeps Axiamatic 's customer engagements organized, on schedule, and well documented. This person supports the Agentic Growth & Value Transformation Leads and the Head of Agentic Growth and Value Transformation across a portfolio of customer accounts. The work spans onboarding, delivery tracking, executive reporting, and value reviews. This is a paid intern-to-hire role for a recent graduate who wants to learn enterprise delivery from the inside. You will sit in customer meetings, track commitments across our team and the customer's team, and turn delivery data into clear reports for executives. As you build judgment, you will take on more of the work yourself, including running smaller workstreams end to end. At the end of the internship, we will decide on conversion to the full-time Agentic Delivery Analyst role based on your performance against the criteria below. We're looking for someone who is excited to learn quickly, and build without waiting for a playbook. You don't need to have all the answers. You just need curiosity and a willingness to dive in! What you'll do

Delivery support and project management

• Maintain project plans, roadmaps, and trackers for each assigned account, and keep them current after every customer touchpoint.

• Track deadlines and action items across Axiamatic 's Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), delivery leads, and customer stakeholders. Follow up when something slips.

• Prepare agendas, take notes, and send clear follow-ups for kickoffs, working sessions, and steering committee meetings.

• Help gather and document customer requirements during onboarding, so FDEs can configure agent solutions against a clear spec.

title: Worker’s Compensation Associate Attorney Review – Compromise & Release
description:
Position Overview
Abramson Labor Group is seeking a detail-oriented attorney to join our Associate Review Team. In this role, you will review and edit Compromise and Release (C&R) agreements before they are filed with the WCAB, so that every settlement we submit is accurate, complete, and positioned for approval. This is a high-volume, deadline-driven position suited to someone who works efficiently, stays organized under pressure, and takes pride in getting the details right the first time.
Key Responsibilities

• Review and edit C&R agreements and related addendums prepared by the settlement team, confirming accuracy and completeness before filing.

• Verify settlement terms against the case file, including ADJ numbers, dates of injury, body parts, settlement amounts, attorney fees, permanent disability advances, liens, and future medical provisions.

• Review addendums and attachments, such as Employment Separation Agreements, Medicare-related language, and other supplemental terms, for consistency with the C&R and compliance with WCAB requirements.

• Identify and correct errors, omissions, and problematic language that could result in an Order Suspending Action (OSA) or delay approval.

• Communicate clearly with Settlement Admins and other internal teams about required corrections so documents move through the pipeline without unnecessary back-and-forth.

• Manage a steady daily caseload, prioritize files by urgency and deadline, and keep reviews moving so settlements are filed on time.

• Maintain accurate status updates and notes in the firm's case management system.

What This Role Requires

•
High-volume capacity. You will review a large number of settlement documents on a daily and weekly basis and must maintain quality at that pace.

•
Deadline management. Hearing dates, filing deadlines, and client expectations drive the work. You must meet turnaround times consistently.

•
Strong organization. You will juggle multiple files at different stages at once, so you need a reliable system for tracking what's pending, what's corrected, and what's ready.

•
Time management and prioritization. You must decide quickly what needs attention first and adjust as priorities shift throughout the day.

•
Exceptional attention to detail. A single wrong date, amount, or missing term can delay a client's settlement, and precision is essential.

•
Clear, efficient communication. You will give concise, actionable feedback to the team and escalate issues when needed.

•
Independence with accountability. You will work through your queue with minimal supervision while knowing when to raise a concern.

• Comfortable with fast-paced work environments

• Excellent writing and verbal communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Candidates must be in good standing with the California State Bar

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with California workers' compensation, particularly on the applicant side.

• Familiarity with C&R drafting, WCAB approval requirements, and common OSA issues.

Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
Benefits
Our law firm offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance coverage. We also provide eligible employees with flexible time off plans including Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), and paid holidays.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform - best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

title: PE Electrical Engineer
description:
Electrical PE
Company: LRS Federal

Location: Corporate / Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Senior Level
Position Overview
LRS Federal is seeking a high-caliber, licensed Electrical PE with an extensive background in federal and defense sectors to join our corporate engineering team. This is not a purely administrative role; we are looking for a senior technical expert who possesses 15+ years of experience and continues to actively perform physical electrical engineering design work.
The successful candidate will lead the design, analysis, and quality control of complex electrical infrastructure projects for the Department of Defense (DoD), Department of Energy (DOE), and civil federal agencies (GSA, VA).
Mandatory Qualifications ("Must-Haves")
Candidates who do not meet all of the following criteria will not be considered:

• Licensure: Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in electrical engineering (with the ability to obtain reciprocity in additional states as required).

• Experience: Minimum of fifteen (15) years of progressive experience working explicitly on Federal and Department of Defense (DoD) infrastructure and facility projects.

• Active Design Footprint: Proven track record of actually performing physical electrical design work within recent roles (producing calculations, single-line diagrams, layouts, and specifications; not just reviewing the work of junior staff).

• Federal Standards Expertise: Deep, practical mastery of Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), National Electrical Code (NEC), NFPA standards, and federal sustainable design mandates.

Key Responsibilities

• Hands-on Electrical Design: Personally execute and oversee the production of comprehensive electrical design packages (Concept through 100% / Issued for Construction) for federal facilities, including medium-voltage distribution, interior power, lighting, grounding, lightning protection, and emergency/standby power systems.

• Engineering Calculations: Perform and seal critical engineering calculations including short-circuit analysis, overcurrent protective device coordination, arc flash studies (using SKM or ETAP software), and voltage drop calculations.

• Design-Build Support: Act as the lead corporate electrical technical authority on major Federal Design-Build (DB) and Design-Bid-Build (DBB) proposals and executed contracts.

• Quality Assurance & Mentorship: Provide rigorous independent technical reviews (QA/QC) for multi-discipline federal design projects while mentoring mid-level and junior electrical designers.

• Client Interfacing: Serve as the technical point of contact during design review conferences with DoD engineering components (e.g., USACE, NAVFAC) and civil agencies.

Technical & Professional Skills

• Expert-level proficiency in electrical engineering design software (e.g., SKM PowerTools, ETAP, AGi32).

• Advanced production capabilities in AutoCAD and Revit MEP for generating construction documents.

• Thorough understanding of physical security, visual/auditory signaling, and telecommunications infrastructure integration within federal footprints.

• Excellent written communication skills for authoring design narratives, basis-of-design (BOD) documents, and physical condition assessment reports.

Salary: $140k-$175k Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Location: Remote, USA
Come Join Our Passionate Team! At Barracuda, we make the world a safer place. We believe every business deserves access to cloud-enabled, enterprise-grade security solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use. We protect email, networks, data and applications with innovative solutions that grow and adapt with our customers’ journey. More than 220,000 organizations worldwide trust Barracuda to protect them - in ways they may not even know they are at risk - so they can focus on taking their business to the next level.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equal employment opportunity and equitable compensation regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
Envision yourself at Barracuda
Barracuda is looking for a highly technical security professional to join our team with a primary focus on identifying emerging threats, understanding evolving adversarial tradecraft, and translating that knowledge into actionable detection and defensive capabilities .
This role sits at the intersection of threat intelligence, detection engineering, offensive security, and adversary emulation . You will research emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, intrusion techniques, and attacker behaviors to understand how modern threats are evolving and how those threats can be detected across Barracuda’s security ecosystem.
You will help answer a critical question for our customers and our organization:
“If an attacker used this technique against us today, would we actually detect it?”
You will investigate how real-world adversaries operate, identify gaps in our ability to detect their behavior, and help develop the telemetry, analytics, detections, and defensive capabilities needed to identify and disrupt them.As a secondary responsibility, you will simulate adversary behavior to validate detection capabilities and expose gaps in defensive coverage. You will safely reproduce attacker TTPs, conduct controlled attack simulations, and measure whether security controls and detections perform as expected.

You will collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Security Operations (XDR), Incident Response, and Product teams to continuously improve Barracuda’s ability to detect and respond to evolving threats.
Being a team player, strong communicator, and forward-thinking security practitioner is essential for success in this role. You will be a technical leader within the team, helping mentor others and advance Barracuda’s capabilities in threat-informed detection and adversary validation.
What You’ll Be Working On
Emerging Threat & Adversarial Tradecraft Research

• Research emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, and adversary campaigns.

• Analyze evolving attacker TTPs and identify new techniques that may impact Barracuda and its customers.

• Track changes in adversary tradecraft and translate findings into actionable defensive requirements.

• Investigate how novel attack techniques can be detected through available telemetry, security controls, and product capabilities.

• Identify gaps in existing detection coverage and recommend improvements to close those gaps.

• Analyze real-world attacks and incidents to identify new detection opportunities and defensive lessons.

• Develop technical assessments of new threats, including attack paths, required telemetry, observable behaviors, and detection opportunities.

• Collaborate with Threat Intelligence and security teams to operationalize emerging threat intelligence.

Detection Development & Validation

• Develop and improve detection strategies for emerging and known adversary behaviors.

• Translate attacker TTPs into detection logic, analytics, behavioral indicators, and detection requirements.

• Evaluate whether existing detections can reliably identify real-world adversary

title: Software Engineer - Trust & Platform Security
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Software Engineer for our Trust & Platform Security team. This team is building the next generation of cyber security monitoring for Snowflake customers where discovery, detection and remediation occurs in the same system. In the agentic era, threats and vulnerabilities occur at machine speed and scale and we are building a platform to detect and respond to these threats in real time. This team is also responsible for building the next generation of network and data enforcement engines: context aware ingress, data exfiltration protection and unified data movement policies for Snowflake's cloud security infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of security policy and system enforcement, building features that help keep perimeter controls robust, scalable, and integrated with context-aware access frameworks.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Build and ship components to detect security vulnerabilities and threats, shadow AI and other agentic threats.

- Develop data loss and ransomware detection mechanisms and ensure signals yield low false positive rates.

- Write and contribute to design documents for product features, with attention to reliability, latency, and auditability

- Work with senior engineers and Product Management to turn requirements into well-scoped tasks and deliver them independently

- Write well-tested, secure code and take part in code reviews

- Own features through implementation, testing, and production rollout with guidance from senior teammates

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY WILL HAVE:

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Working knowledge of network security fundamentals (TLS/SSL, HTTP/S, DNS), Zero Trust principles, or Data Loss Prevention (DLP) concepts

- Solid coding skills in SQL, Java, Python and exposure to building distributed or backend systems and willingness for full stack exposure

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and their security or networking controls

- Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow ownership over larger parts of the system

- Clear communication and comfort collaborating with cross-functional partners

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Exposure to cloud-native security controls (e.g., VPC Service Controls, Private Link)

- Experience with egress control, network perimeter enforcement, or policy engines

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling

- Contributions to open-source security projects, security research, or CTFs

WHY JOIN OUR TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will work on security controls that protect customer data across Snowflake, at a scale few companies operate. This is an early-career role with real ownership: you will ship production features in a high-impact security area while learning from experienced infrastructure and security engineers.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Sales Enablement & Operations team member. Our go-to-market team is growing fast (AEs, a new BDR team, demand gen, and a GTM Engineer), and the systems, processes, and knowledge that got us here were built by founders on the fly. This role exists to turn that into a real operating engine: one where every rep ramps quickly, knows exactly how to tell the Lorikeet story, and spends their time selling instead of fighting the CRM. You'll own training, operations, and process not just for sales, but for our Forward Deployed team too.

We sell into regulated, high-stakes businesses, and our buyers are sharp. A Head of Support at a telehealth company wants to know how the AI handles a compliance edge case; a fintech CX leader wants proof it won't get someone's money stuck. Our reps need to go deep on product, industry, and objections, and you'll be the person who makes sure they can.

You'll sit at the centre of sales, marketing, product, and our Forward Deployed team, and you'll own both sides of the job: the enablement (onboarding, playbooks, messaging, coaching) and the operations (CRM, pipeline hygiene, forecasting, reporting, tooling).

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Own onboarding and training for every new GTM and Forward Deployed hire. Design a ramp program that gets AEs, BDRs, and Forward Deployed team members confident in front of customers in weeks, not quarters

- Build and maintain the sales playbook: ICP and personas, discovery frameworks, qualification criteria, objection handling, competitive positioning, and vertical-specific plays for fintech, healthtech, marketplaces, and delivery

- Turn product launches and customer wins into enablement: talk tracks, demo flows, case studies, and battlecards reps actually use

- Have experience building an enablement program from the ground up

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives.
About the Transport Programme
The ACF Transport Programme supports an African-led transition to clean, safe, affordable and accessible transport. It works on the policy, finance and public support needed to move people and goods more sustainably, and treats electric mobility as one part of a wider shift that also covers public and popular transport such as buses and minibus taxis. Working with governments, financial institutions, civil society, research partners and the private sector, the programme combines grant-making, technical assistance, research, convening and advocacy. It also collaborates with partners and global initiatives, so that African priorities shape how transport systems are planned and financed.
Purpose
Reporting to Transport Programme Manager, the Senior Programme Officer will play a pivotal role in implementing the Transport Programme’s Africa strategy, supporting the Programme Manager to deliver a continent-wide mobility transition. The role is suited for someone with a deep understanding of Africa’s transport and energy landscape, strong project management skills, and a passion for accelerating climate and industrial transformation.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, civil society partners, multilateral institutions, and technical collaborators.

title: Revenue Cycle Manager
description:
Job description:

Revenue Cycle Manager

The Revenue Cycle Manager will serve as a hands-on player-coach, overseeing billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and financial operations for ABA Therapy Partners. This role is ideal for a strategic, solutions-oriented leader who can manage day-to-day operations while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, improve accuracy, strengthen collections, and reduce manual processes through automation and scalable solutions. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of revenue cycle best practices, billing requirements, authorization processes, and reimbursement rules for California regional centers, school districts, and insurance payers. Reporting directly to the CEO, this individual will play a key role in strengthening financial processes, improving revenue performance, and building the operational infrastructure needed to support the company’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Process Improvement

•
Process Mapping: Document every finance workflow end to end (session data to invoice to payment to cash to month-end close) with clear owners, inputs, outputs, deadlines, and handoffs.

•
Find and Fix Friction: Identify bottlenecks, rework, duplicate entry, and error sources. Prioritize fixes by impact on the business.

•
Automation: Lead automation across billing, AR, AP, and reporting using our systems (HiRasmus, Lumary, Rippling, Quickbooks, Google Workspace) and other tools as needed.

•
Standard Operating Procedures: Write and maintain SOPs and checklists so any team member can be trained to run each process the same way every time.

•
Controls: Build in checks that catch errors before they reach a client or vendor, with clear separation of duties and approval rules.

•
Continuous Improvement: Set baselines, track improvement, and report what changed each quarter.

2. Billing

•
Billing Cycle: Lead the monthly billing cycle for all clients we directly invoice, including Regional Centers and School Districts. Work directly with outsourced billing partners to drive prompt and accurate insurance client billing and collections.

•
Data Integrity: Partner with the appointment rendering and scheduling teams so the data used for billing is clean and complete before billing begins. Close the gaps that cause unrendered or unbilled sessions.

•
Client Billing: Convert documented sessions and session notes into invoices based on authorized hours, rates, and codes (e.g., regional center Purchase of Service agreements and school district contracts and IEPs).

•
Invoice Submission: Manage submissions according to each client's requirements, and resolve discrepancies or denials quickly.

3. Accounts Receivable and Collections

•
AR Management: Own the AR aging, follow up on overdue invoices, and drive down days sales outstanding (DSO), regardless of payer source or billing method.

•
Cash Application: Post incoming payments accurately in our Practice Management system and reconcile them to invoices.

•
Denials and Disputes: Track root causes of short pays, denials, and disputes, and fix the process upstream so they don't repeat.

•
Outsourced Billing Partners: Own the relationship to drive partnership, data integrity, clean claims, prompt payment and collections.

•
Self Pay / Patient Responsibility: Work with families in a professional, respectful manner to establish payment plans and otherwise collect on copays, coinsurance and other patient responsibility items.

4. Accounts Payable

•
Vendor Payments: Manage vendor setup, invoice intake, approvals, and payments on a predictable schedule, meeting vendor payment terms.

•
Approval Workflow: Enforce spending approval thresholds and documentation, and keep AP clean for audits.

•
Spend Visibility: Track recurring spend and subscriptions. Identify savings opportunities.

5. Finance Operations

•
Monthly Financial Rhythm: Define and run a monthly calendar for billing, collections, payment posting, AP, recon

description:
About Reap
Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.
Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services-from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.
Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale Reap 's client activation and onboarding experience as we expand into new markets and unlock new use cases. Client Activation is the company's #1 objective - this role sits at the centre of it.
You will design onboarding that turns regulatory complexity into a competitive advantage: fast, compliant, consistent client activation across geographies, products, and flow types, built on systems that scale and differentiate Reap in the market.
What You'll Do

• End-to-end activation funnels - from application through identity verification, KYC/KYB, AML screening, risk assessment, account setup, and first value. Our core motion is B2B, with consumer use cases alongside it.

• The verification and AML stack in-product - identity and entity verification (KYC/KYB), document and registry checks, sanctions and PEP screening, risk decisioning, and controls that keep us audit-ready across jurisdictions.

• Vendor and orchestration strategy - select, integrate, and get the most out of KYC/KYB providers, identity verification vendors, and workflow engines.

• Scalable onboarding architecture - configurable flows, rules, and decisioning that adapt to jurisdiction-specific requirements without bespoke rebuilds, plus the activation playbook that lets Reap enter new markets and launch new use cases faster each time.

• Regulatory-by-design product thinking - partner deeply with Compliance and Legal to translate licensing and regulatory obligations into product requirements that don't compromise client experience.

• Cross-functional orchestration - partner closely with Engineering day-to-day, and work across Ops, Compliance, and GTM to remove friction, reduce manual review, and improve conversion and time-to-activate.

• Metrics and iteration - own activation funnel metrics (conversion, time-to-activation, verification speed, manual review rates, drop-off by stage and market), run experiments, and drive a roadmap grounded in data.

What We’re Looking For

• Built B2B onboarding/activation systems in regulated fintech - hands-on PM experience shipping client onboarding, KYC/KYB, or activation products. B2B is essential; exposure to consumer onboarding is valuable too.

• Deep fluency in the AML stack - identity verification, KYC/KYB, sanctions and PEP screening, licensing, and data requirements across geographies, product lines, and flow types - plus hands-on experience with onboarding vendors and orchestration tools (KYC/KYB providers, identity verification vendors, workflow engines).

• Thinks holistically - weighs client experience, legal and regulatory requirements, and operationalising together in every product decision; treats compliance as a constraint to design within, not an obstacle to route around.

• Systems thinker - builds scalable, configurable systems (rules engines, modular flows, reusable components), not market-by-market one-offs.

• Client experience obsession - judges every flow by how it feels to a good client: fewer steps, less friction, faster to first value.

• Data-driven - defines metrics, diagnoses drop-off, and prioritises by impact.

• Thinks and acts AI-first - uses AI across how they work and what they build.

title: Rural Partners Corps (RPC) - Host Site Application
description:
Note: This application is for Rural Partners Corps (RPC) host sites for the 2026-27 Program Year, featuring a December 2026 - August 2027 term of service. We welcome applications from partners nationwide. Submitting this form is a way to indicate general interest only -organizations are not committing to participate by applying. We encourage interested partners to complete this form as soon as possible.
About the Rural Partners Corps
Rural Partners Corps (RPC) is a new AmeriCorps service fellowship from Lead For America (LFA) that places locally rooted Members with rural, place-based backbone organizations.
Members already live in or near the communities they serve. They bring local knowledge, transferable skills, relationships, and a commitment to making their communities stronger.
RPC Members serve 40 hours per week from December through August, working alongside Host Site staff and community partners to build organizational and community capacity and advance cradle-to-career economic mobility for rural young people.
Who Should Apply?
RPC Host Sites are place-based backbone organizations serving rural communities or regions. Eligible entities include:

• Regional or community-based nonprofits

• Community Development Corporations (CDCs) & Economic Development Organizations (EDOs)

• Cradle-to-career partnerships & collective impact initiatives

• Community foundations & philanthropic organizations

• Tribal governments & Native-led organizations

• Local government agencies & regional councils of government

• Education organizations (K12 through Higher Education Institutions)

What Does Your Organization Gain?
Dedicated Capacity: A full-time Member focused on meaningful projects that advance your organization's priorities.
Stronger Partnerships: Additional capacity to build relationships, convene partners, and connect community assets.
Organizational Infrastructure: Tools, systems, research, processes, volunteer infrastructure, and other resources that strengthen your organization's capacity.
Local Talent: A motivated community member who already knows and cares about the place-and wants to contribute to its future.
LFA Support: Your Member receives ongoing coaching and professional development through LFA, while your organization has a dedicated LFA Program Coordinator as an additional source of support.
What Will an RPC Member Do?
An RPC Member joins your organization as a locally rooted capacity-building partner.
They are not an intern, temporary worker, outside consultant, or replacement for existing staff. Instead, they bring their skills, relationships, local knowledge, and initiative to help your organization move important community priorities forward.
Members will typically:
1. Know the Place

• Conduct community asset mapping and listening

• Learn the community's strengths, priorities, relationships, and existing initiatives

2. Build Relationships

• Engage community stakeholders and partners

• Support cross-sector collaboration and community convenings

• Connect people, organizations, and resources

3. Understand & Advance Priorities

• Support strategic planning and implementation

• Coordinate projects and initiatives

• Conduct research and organize information

• Help move locally defined priorities from ideas to action

4. Build Capacity

• Develop tools, processes, resources, and systems

• Strengthen partnership, communication, or volunteer infrastructure and engagement

• Support training, workshops, outreach, and community engagement

5. Support Cradle-to-Career & Economic Mobility

• Contribute to initiatives involving youth, education, workforce development, career pathways, and economic mobility

• Help strengthen connections across schools, nonprofits, employers, government, higher education, and other community partners

The Member's approach is: Know the Place → Build Relationships → Understand Priorities → Organize → Connect → Execute → Build Capacity
Specific assignments will be shaped by you

At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Trust & Safety within Render’s Security team. Your mission is to keep Render a trusted place to build and run applications by preventing fraud and abuse, protecting customers from malicious activity, and making it harder for attackers to use our platform.

You’ll lead a team of engineers who build and operate the systems behind this work: detection pipelines, investigation tools, automated enforcement, and protections across the customer lifecycle. You’ll combine strong people leadership with technical judgement, helping the team respond effectively to incidents while investing in systems that prevent recurring problems.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Infrastructure, customer-facing teams, Finance, and Legal to translate emerging threats and customer needs into practical engineering work. The decisions your team makes will directly affect customer safety, platform reputation, fraud losses, and the experience of legitimate developers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead and grow the Trust & Safety engineering team through hiring, mentorship, regular feedback, performance management, and career development.

- Define the team’s roadmap, balancing investigations and operational needs with sustained investments in prevention, automation, and platform protections.

- Guide the design and delivery of systems that detect phishing, malicious workloads, payment fraud, and other forms of platform abuse.

- Build investigation and enforcement tooling that gives responders the context to act quickly, records decisions, and supports consistent handling of escalations and appeals.

Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. Deliveroo Editions were the world's first delivery-only kitchens, and we are still the market leaders in helping our restaurant partners succeed. What’s even more exciting is that we’re expanding our portfolio further.

- Step 2: if your application is successful, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

- Step 3: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

- Step 4: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

- Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

title: Solutions Architect, EMEA
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE
As a Solutions Architect at Baseten you will partner closely with Sales and customers to translate business needs into technical solutions, run technical discovery, and guide repeatable deployments and proofs of value for customers. This role is a great fit for entrepreneurial, customer-facing technical professionals who want a front-row view into how modern companies adopt AI at scale, and who enjoy working across technical discovery, solution design, demos, deployment scoping, and hands-on customer implementations, in close partnership with Sales and Engineering.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Partner with Sales on customer discovery calls (most often second calls, occasionally first calls for large accounts).

- Lead demos and technical scoping to align on success criteria, architecture, and deployment approach.

- Own benchmarking and repeatable deployments, including:

- Handling standard deployment patterns and configurations across many modalities - LLMs, embeddings, image and video generation, Voice AI, etc.

- Advising on tradeoffs like H100s vs B200s and latency-optimized vs throughput-optimized setups.

- Driving consistent “playbook” style deployments for common models and use cases.

- Become a power user of different runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, and TRT-LLM and all the common configurations and tradeoffs between them

- Drive POC and project execution, including:

- Scoping POCs and keeping stakeholders aligned on timeline, deliverables, and next steps.

- Acting as the “ringleader” or project manager for POCs.

- Pulling in Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) support when deeper or more complex technical work is needed.

REQUIREMENTS

- AI/ML background and the ability to credibly discuss AI/ML topics with technical stakeholders.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to run structured discovery and clarify ambiguous requirements.

- Technical depth to scope solutions, without needing to write production code.

- Ability to script and prototype as needed, including comfort “vibe coding” to move quickly in technical workflows.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience running or supporting benchmarks for ML inference deployments.

- Familiarity with infrastructure tradeoffs relevant to inference performance and cost (for example GPU selection and latency versus throughput tuning).

- Experience serving as a cross-functional technical lead for customer POCs, including coordination across Sales and Engineering.

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

- Paid parental leave

- Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

- (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

- Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants

The successful candidate will consider each participant's medical, physical, emotional, social, cultural, spiritual, financial, and family circumstances when developing recommendations and delivering services. The Social Worker will also educate participants, caregivers, and staff regarding aging, dementia, grief and loss, end-of-life considerations, chronic disease, family dynamics, and the care model. This position requires an active New York State LMSW license, at least one year of post-MSW experience, strong electronic documentation skills, and the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an interdisciplinary healthcare team.

As an AI Engineer, you will design, build, and productionize scalable Generative AI solutions, focusing on applied AI engineering and backend development. • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in software architecture and engineering best practices.

• Strong Python skills and proven experience developing and scaling backend services in production environments.

• Deep technical knowledge of Generative AI, including LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, multi-step AI workflows, and prompt engineering.

• Hands-on experience integrating foundational models into application workflows and using frameworks such as LlamaIndex and embedding optimization techniques.

GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE GTM TEAM

The Go-to-Market team at GenLogs is responsible for bringing our nationwide commercial-vehicle intelligence platform to the agencies and enterprises that depend on trustworthy, real-time freight visibility. We work directly with state and federal law-enforcement partners, departments of transportation, ports, shippers, carriers, and brokers to define problems, scope operational deployments, and scale high-impact programs. As the commercial face of GenLogs, we translate the capabilities of our sensor network and freight intelligence data platform into clear value propositions that strengthen public safety, reduce fraud and theft, and improve supply-chain reliability. The team operates with urgency, precision, and deep market understanding, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to ensure our solutions solve the most important problems in the freight ecosystem.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) drives top-of-funnel pipeline across LSPs, Shippers, and accounts within GenLogs’ commercial auto insurance vertical. This includes working with retailers, wholesalers, carriers, and MGAs.

This role requires strong communication skills, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to operate within both mid-market and enterprise outbound motions. Based on experience, candidates may focus on strategic enterprise accounts or mid-market accounts.

You will work closely with Account Executives, Product, and Customer Success to understand buyer pain points, refine and develop messaging, and contribute to the broader go-to-market strategy.

title: Certified Inpatient Medical Coder - Remote
description:
Job Title: Certified Inpatient Medical Coder
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote, United States
Job Summary
We are seeking a Certified Inpatient Medical Coder to contribute to an AI training project focused on improving medical data accuracy and integrity. In this role, you will apply your expertise in inpatient coding, clinical documentation, and coding guidelines to review medical records and evaluate AI-generated clinical content. Your knowledge will help improve the accuracy and reliability of AI systems.
Key Responsibilities

• Review inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding in accordance with current guidelines and best practices.

• Assess clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and coding integrity.

• Identify principal and secondary diagnoses, sequence codes according to official guidelines, and assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators.

• Validate MS-DRG assignments, identify Complications and Comorbidities (CCs) and Major Complications and Comorbidities (MCCs), and flag Hospital-Acquired Conditions (HACs) and patient safety indicators.

• Evaluate AI-generated clinical notes and summaries against real-world documentation and coding standards.

• Code AI-generated diagnostic and procedural information using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS classification systems.

• Identify and resolve diagnosis and procedure coding discrepancies to maintain accurate record abstraction and data capture.

• Provide clear, detailed feedback on coding errors and complex cases to improve AI model performance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active coding certification, such as CIC, CCS, RHIA, RHIT, COC, or another relevant AHIMA or AAPC credential.

• Hands-on experience with inpatient ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding.

• Access to current official ICD-10-CM/PCS coding references and Coding Clinic guidance.

• Current experience in inpatient medical coding, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or a closely related documentation role.

• Availability to commit at least 10 hours per week.
